notes: ClusterPower inaugurated on 1 April 2022 in Mischii commune, Dolj county (25,427 sqm site) the largest data center in Romania - first hyperscale in South-Eastern Europe - a 25,000 sqm AI one-stop-shop technology park with Nvidia DGX A100 supercomputing, initial investment ~EUR 36-40 million (172 million lei, incl. 82 million lei state aid). Campus plans five data centers fed by an on-site gas-fired power plant of up to 200 MW; direct connection to Transelectrica grid and Transgaz network. Construction of the first of the five centers was ongoing as of 2023 per founder interviews.
